spans.s: jīva-loka (EI 3), a village institution of uncertain meaning.
jīvana (SITI), maintenance; cf. jīvaṇa-śiṣa. See also bhṛtyebhyo jīvanam kartuṃ (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, pp. 109-10).
Jīva-putrā, Prakrit Jīva-putā (EI 24), a lady whose son is (or, sons are) still living.
jīvita (EI 28; SII 13; ASLV; SITI), maintenance; income or wages; also called jīvita-ppar̤r̤u, jita and jīta.
Jivita-kkārar (SITI), persons in enjoyment of lands in the jīvita (maintenance) tenure; a class of officials enjoying jīvita.
